verdict.rationale: GitLab's docs mention Secret Detection as part of a consolidated scanning platform with findings surfacing in merge requests/IDEs, which supports detection of leaked secrets, but there is no specific evidence of organization-wide scanning across all repos, remediation workflows (revocation, rotation, historic commit scrubbing), or any alerting/dashboard for leaked secrets specifically. Missing for 10: org-wide/cross-repo secret scanning details, concrete remediation workflow (auto-revoke, git history purge), independent/hands-on validation of Secret Detection efficacy.
